svg.title: The inverse follows either by finite Möbius inversion or subset induction. Assume gx(A) →g0(A) as x ↓0; uniqueness for x > 0 makes Jf(A) = g0(A) model independent. A paid model has |gx(A)| ≤b(A) and P A b(A) ≤c uniformly in configurations, so |f(x, R)| ≤c. For square-zero marker elements zi, define Sz(f) = X A⊆I Jf(A) Y i∈A zi.
